import sys

MOD = 1000000007

class Matrix:
    def __init__(self, *args):
        if len(args) == 0:
            self.M = []
        elif len(args) == 2:
            r, c = args
            self.M = [[0] * c for _ in range(r)]
        elif len(args) == 1:
            n = args[0]
            self.M = [[0] * n for _ in range(n)]
        else:
            raise ValueError("Invalid arguments for Matrix constructor")
    
    def rows(self):
        return len(self.M)
    
    def cols(self):
        return len(self.M[0]) if self.M else 0
    
    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        return self.M[idx]
    
    def __setitem__(self, idx, value):
        self.M[idx] = value
    
    @staticmethod
    def I(n):
        res = Matrix(n)
        for i in range(n):
            res[i][i] = 1
        return res
    
    def __iadd__(self, other):
        assert self.rows() == other.rows() and self.cols() == other.cols()
        for i in range(self.rows()):
            for j in range(self.cols()):
                self.M[i][j] = (self.M[i][j] + other.M[i][j]) % MOD
        return self
    
    def __isub__(self, other):
        assert self.rows() == other.rows() and self.cols() == other.cols()
        for i in range(self.rows()):
            for j in range(self.cols()):
                self.M[i][j] = (self.M[i][j] - other.M[i][j] + MOD) % MOD
        return self
    
    def __imul__(self, other):
        r = self.rows()
        c = other.cols()
        m = self.cols()
        assert m == other.rows()
        tmp = [[0] * c for _ in range(r)]
        for i in range(r):
            for k in range(m):
                for j in range(c):
                    tmp[i][j] = (tmp[i][j] + self.M[i][k] * other.M[k][j]) % MOD
        self.M = tmp
        return self
    
    def __ipow__(self, exp):
        res = Matrix.I(self.rows())
        base = Matrix(self.rows())
        for i in range(self.rows()):
            for j in range(self.cols()):
                base.M[i][j] = self.M[i][j]
        while exp > 0:
            if exp & 1:
                res *= base
            base *= base
            exp >>= 1
        self.M = [row[:] for row in res.M]
        return self
    
    def __add__(self, other):
        t = Matrix(self.rows(), self.cols())
        for i in range(self.rows()):
            for j in range(self.cols()):
                t.M[i][j] = self.M[i][j]
        t += other
        return t
    
    def __sub__(self, other):
        t = Matrix(self.rows(), self.cols())
        for i in range(self.rows()):
            for j in range(self.cols()):
                t.M[i][j] = self.M[i][j]
        t -= other
        return t
    
    def __mul__(self, other):
        t = Matrix(self.rows(), other.cols())
        for i in range(self.rows()):
            for j in range(other.cols()):
                for k in range(self.cols()):
                    t.M[i][j] = (t.M[i][j] + self.M[i][k] * other.M[k][j]) % MOD
        return t
    
    def __pow__(self, exp):
        t = Matrix(self.rows(), self.cols())
        for i in range(self.rows()):
            for j in range(self.cols()):
                t.M[i][j] = self.M[i][j]
        t **= exp
        return t
    
    def det(self):
        C = Matrix(self.rows(), self.cols())
        for i in range(self.rows()):
            for j in range(self.cols()):
                C.M[i][j] = self.M[i][j]
        assert self.rows() == self.cols()
        d = 1
        n = self.rows()
        for i in range(n):
            p = -1
            for j in range(i, n):
                if C.M[j][i] != 0:
                    p = j
                    break
            if p == -1:
                return 0
            if i != p:
                d = (d * (MOD - 1)) % MOD
                C.M[i], C.M[p] = C.M[p], C.M[i]
            d = (d * C.M[i][i]) % MOD
            inv = self.modinv(C.M[i][i], MOD)
            for j in range(n):
                C.M[i][j] = (C.M[i][j] * inv) % MOD
            for j in range(i + 1, n):
                f = C.M[j][i]
                for k in range(n):
                    C.M[j][k] = (C.M[j][k] - C.M[i][k] * f) % MOD
                    if C.M[j][k] < 0:
                        C.M[j][k] += MOD
        return (d % MOD + MOD) % MOD
    
    @staticmethod
    def modinv(a, m):
        x, y, mm = 0, 1, m
        if m == 1:
            return 0
        while a > 1:
            q = a // m
            t = m
            m = a % m
            a = t
            t = x
            x = y - q * x
            y = t
        if y < 0:
            y += mm
        return y
    
    def transform(self, K):
        Tmp = Matrix(self.rows())
        for i in range(K):
            for j in range(K):
                Tmp.M[i][j] = self.M[(i + K - 1) % K][(j + K - 1) % K]
            Tmp.M[i][K] = self.M[(i + K - 1) % K][K]
            Tmp.M[K][i] = self.M[K][(i + K - 1) % K]
        Tmp.M[K][K] = self.M[K][K]
        self.M = [row[:] for row in Tmp.M]

def fastpow(b, e):
    if e == 0:
        return 1
    r = fastpow(b, e // 2)
    r = (r * r) % MOD
    if e & 1:
        r = (r * b) % MOD
    return r

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    N_val = int(data[0])
    K_val = int(data[1])
    
    K = K_val
    
    depth = 0
    tmp = N_val
    while tmp >= K:
        depth += 1
        tmp //= K
    
    pre = [[None] * 35 for _ in range(70)]
    
    pre[0][0] = Matrix.I(K + 1)
    for i in range(1, K + 1):
        pre[0][0][0][i] = 1
    
    for i in range(1, K):
        pre[0][i] = Matrix(pre[0][i-1].rows(), pre[0][i-1].cols())
        for r in range(pre[0][i-1].rows()):
            for c in range(pre[0][i-1].cols()):
                pre[0][i].M[r][c] = pre[0][i-1].M[r][c]
        pre[0][i].transform(K)
    
    for lvl in range(1, depth + 1):
        pre[lvl][0] = Matrix(pre[lvl-1][0].rows(), pre[lvl-1][0].cols())
        for r in range(pre[lvl-1][0].rows()):
            for c in range(pre[lvl-1][0].cols()):
                pre[lvl][0].M[r][c] = pre[lvl-1][0].M[r][c]
        for i in range(1, K):
            pre[lvl][0] = pre[lvl-1][i] * pre[lvl][0]
        for i in range(1, K):
            pre[lvl][i] = Matrix(pre[lvl][i-1].rows(), pre[lvl][i-1].cols())
            for r in range(pre[lvl][i-1].rows()):
                for c in range(pre[lvl][i-1].cols()):
                    pre[lvl][i].M[r][c] = pre[lvl][i-1].M[r][c]
            pre[lvl][i].transform(K)
    
    res = Matrix(K + 1, 1)
    res[K][0] = 1
    offset = 0
    
    while depth >= 0:
        while True:
            if fastpow(K, depth) <= N_val:
                N_val -= fastpow(K, depth)
                res = pre[depth][offset] * res
                offset = (offset + 1) % K
            else:
                break
        depth -= 1
    
    ans = 0
    for i in range(K + 1):
        ans = (ans + res[i][0]) % MOD
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
